description: The complete Spain income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: State and regional IRPF scales of all 15 common-regime communities and Ceuta/Melilla, with regional minimums; Employment income: expenses, work reduction, irregular income, work abroad, minimum-wage deduction (RDL 5/2026); Self-employment (estimación directa), rented and vacant property with the housing-law reductions; Savings base: interest, dividends, capital gains, main-home exemptions, 25% loss offsetting and carry-forward; Pension plans, joint return (married or single parent) compared with separate returns, Beckham regime, non-residents; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in EUR; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.
